# AlkoRater — Full Project Description

AlkoRater is an offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) for rating and tracking alcohol consumption. It targets the Polish market with a catalog of hundreds of beers, vodkas, and wines stored in offline JSON files.

## Architecture

- **Static SPA** — single `index.html` entry point, no build step, no frameworks
- **Module-based JavaScript** — ES modules under `src/js/` organized into `app/`, `data/`, `services/`, `ui/`, `utils/`
- **Offline-first** — all assets pre-cached via Service Worker; product data served stale-while-revalidate
- **IndexedDB** — user ratings and favorites persisted locally via `idb` wrapper

## Key Features

- Offline alcohol rating (1–5 stars + notes)
- Search with debounce across product database
- Dashboard with stats, recently rated, favorites
- Category filtering (beer, vodka, wine)
- PWA installable (manifest.json + Service Worker)
- iOS-style dark mode design with glassmorphism

## Data Model

Each rating record:
- `id` (auto-generated)
- `name` — product name
- `category` — Piwo / Wódka / Wino
- `alcohol` — ABV percentage
- `rating` — 1–5 integer
- `note` — optional text note
- `timestamp` — ISO date

## PWA Capabilities

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Service Worker | Cache-first for static, stale-while-revalidate for JSON data |
| Manifest | Standalone display, portrait orientation, maskable icons |
| Offline | Full offline operation — cached assets + JSON + IndexedDB |
| Installable | `beforeinstallprompt` + manifest links |
| Update Flow | SKIP_WAITING + MessageChannel handshake with update banner |

## Deployment

- Hosted on GitHub Pages: https://t91a60.github.io/AlkoRater/
- CI/CD via GitHub Actions (lint + deploy on push to main)
- Zero build step — static files served directly

## Repository Structure

```
/
├── index.html          # Entry point (SPA shell)
├── manifest.json       # Web App Manifest
├── service-worker.js   # Offline cache & update logic
├── favicon.ico
├── robots.txt
├── sitemap.xml
├── humans.txt
├── llms.txt
├── llms-full.txt
├── README.md
├── data/               # Product JSON files (beer, vodka, wine)
├── icons/              # PWA icons (60, 180, 192, 512)
├── src/
│   ├── css/style.css   # All styles (no CSS frameworks)
│   └── js/
│       ├── main.js     # App entry point
│       ├── app/        # Constants, state manager, event bus
│       ├── data/       # Data access layer (repositories)
│       ├── services/   # Storage, search, data loader, SW service
│       ├── ui/         # Dashboard, search, favorites, modal, tabs, toast, haptics, renderer
│       └── utils/      # DOM helpers, debounce, logger
├── .github/workflows/  # CI + deploy pipelines
├── package.json
├── .eslintrc.json
├── .stylelintrc.json
└── .prettierrc.json
```

## Technologies

- Vanilla HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript (ES2024)
- IndexedDB (via `idb` wrapper in storage.js)
- Service Worker API
- Web App Manifest
- ESLint + Stylelint + Prettier
- GitHub Actions (CI + GitHub Pages deploy)
